Hellhounds are primarily killed for their [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue scroll]] drops, as they drop them at a much higher rate compared to most other non-boss/superior monsters. As they are [[demonic (attribute)|demonic]], they are weak to [[demonbane weapons]]. In order to be assigned them as a slayer task, the player must have 75 combat (unless it is not counted). Players with 91 [[Slayer]] may also kill [[Cerberus]] as an alternative to a hellhound task. Other alternatives include the skeleton hellhounds from [[Calvar'ion]] and [[Vet'ion]], or [[reanimated hellhound]]s spawned by using [[Expert Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled hellhound head]].
